release_notes: Terminal package access controls: hosting_packages now carries shell_access (disabled/jailed/normal), terminal, ssh_access, sftp, api_shell, cron. Package editor (edit + create) has a Shell & Terminal Access card. /user/terminal is gated on the package permission (denied view + API block when disabled). Feature lists already had ssh_access/terminal/cron_jobs/git_access/api_access flags. Verified: testacct (jailed+terminal) gets real PTY shell; with terminal=0 the customer sees 'Terminal Not Available' and session create returns an error. Migration 2026_09_18_terminal_package_access.
